purpose: Connected EasyEDA WIRE groups, native pin IDs, NetFlags, and NC truth for PDF pages 2-6

geometry_contract.wire_group_rule: same exact net plus shared endpoint, endpoint-on-segment, collinear overlap, or explicit-junction crossing
geometry_contract.plain_crossing_rule: interior/interior crossing without a PDF junction stays in separate WIRE groups
geometry_contract.supplemental_wire_rule: direct NetFlag/physical-pin coincidences get a separate non-zero WIRE over the already drawn NetFlag pin stroke; these do not alter source segment/group counts

native_contract.wire_note: API-created native wire probe retained empty Relevance; electrical association is geometric
native_contract.supplemental_wire_note: Create each supplemental_wire_group as its own WIRE with one LINE plus exact-case NET and empty Relevance attributes

power_probe.warning: These exact IDs are the probed Power flag only; use createNetFlag for Ground/ProtectGround rather than guessing IDs

native_contract.pwr_flag_note: All seven KiCad PWR_FLAG instances are native type-18 NetFlag translations whose Name and Global Net Name both equal the exact rail, while their library PIN keeps type OUT; using the literal component value PWR_FLAG as Name merges the seven rails during native netlist compilation
